tools.name: base64_encode
tools.description: Encode a string to base64. Useful when you need to base64-encode data for URLs, APIs, or data URIs.

tools.name: base64_decode
tools.description: Decode a base64 string back to plain text. Useful for decoding base64-encoded data from APIs or files.

tools.name: hash
tools.description: Generate a SHA256 or MD5 hash of a string. Returns the hex-encoded digest. Use for checksums, fingerprinting, or when the user asks for a hash.

tools.name: uuid_v4
tools.description: Generate a random UUID v4 string. Use when the user needs a unique identifier.

tools.name: json_format
tools.description: Pretty-print a JSON string with indentation. Useful for making minified or messy JSON readable.

tools.name: json_validate
tools.description: Validate whether a string is valid JSON. Returns the parsed structure summary if valid, or the error if not.

tools.name: count_text
tools.description: Count words, characters, and lines in a string. Use for questions like 'how many words is this' or 'how long is this text'.

tools.name: case_convert
tools.description: Convert text between different case styles: upper, lower, title, snake, kebab, camel, or pascal.

tools.name: slugify
tools.description: Convert text into a URL-friendly slug (lowercase, hyphens instead of spaces, special characters removed).

tools.name: extract_urls
tools.description: Extract all URLs (http/https) from a block of text. Returns the list of URLs found.

text.description: The text to scan for URLs

tools.name: extract_emails
tools.description: Extract all email addresses from a block of text. Returns the list of addresses found.

text.description: The text to scan for email addresses
